post_excerpt: Clear explanations of HLS and M3U8 terms including master playlists, media playlists, variants, segments, CORS and encryption tags.
post_content:
A practical glossary for common HLS and M3U8 terms used by player, checker, troubleshooting and publishing pages.

Playlist terms

  • M3U8: a UTF-8 playlist format commonly used by HLS streams.
  • HLS: HTTP Live Streaming, a segmented adaptive streaming protocol.
  • Master playlist: a playlist that points to multiple variant streams.
  • Media playlist: a playlist that lists media segments for one rendition.
  • Variant: one bitrate, resolution or codec option inside an adaptive stream.
  • Segment: a small media file requested by the player.

Access and protection terms

  • CORS: browser cross-origin policy that can block JavaScript requests.
  • 403: a server response indicating the current request is not authorized.
  • Signed URL: a URL that may expire or depend on a token, cookie or referrer.
  • EXT-X-KEY: a playlist tag indicating encrypted media segments.
  • DRM: a rights-management boundary that browser tools should not attempt to bypass.
